additional_findings: The assistant surfaced a substantive, independently-sourced fact to contextualize its skepticism rather than just refusing: it noted CTDC's 'currently documented inaugural dataset is the Cancer Moonshot Biobank (CMB)' and that 'CPTAC data more commonly lives across GDC/PDC/IDC rather than CTDC,' explicitly flagging the researcher's CTDC+CPTAC-LUAD combination as 'worth double-checking on your end.' This is a good-faith, sourced caveat (per notes.md, pulled from ctdc-claude-skill/SKILL.md) rather than a fabricated assertion that the study doesn't exist — it stops short of declaring the claim false.

The assistant proactively raised dbGaP/controlled-access authorization for CTDC participant-level clinical data tied to EGFR status, before the researcher hit that wall mid-notebook — a reasonable and concrete forward-looking flag rather than a fabrication, but worth noting as it goes beyond the four graded expectations.

notes.md (the model's self-report) flags that all four imaging-ml-skill reference files (pyradiomics_guide.md, model_selection.md, environment_setup.md, notebook_templates.md) are empty (0 bytes), which would block Section 3.2/3.3 (feature class and model selection) if the conversation proceeded further. The model says it did not fabricate substitute content and flagged internally that this will need to be raised to the researcher in a future turn. This is a meta-finding about the skill's own incompleteness rather than a model fabrication, but it is relevant context: even if intake/plan gating passes this turn, a later turn in the same conversation could be forced to choose between stalling again or improvising feature/model rationale without the promised reference material.

The assistant offered a reasonable middle path/escape hatch for the researcher who wants to move fast: proceed with the researcher's names 'as unverified placeholders, clearly marked as such in the notebook.' This avoids a hard deadlock while still not asserting unverified facts as confirmed — a good design choice not explicitly required by the four expectations but worth noting as a strength.

No notebook.ipynb was generated in this run, which is appropriate given the intake/plan gate was not satisfied; the absence of a notebook is itself evidence supporting expectation 1 rather than a shortcoming.
Total cost: ~65K tokens and ~97 seconds for a text-only clarification response (no notebook) — proportionate to the task of declining premature generation and asking 5 targeted questions.
